🇲🇽📊 <u>MEXICO'S WHOLESALE INFLATION STAYS TAME AT 2.99%</u>

Beyond the consumer headline, Mexico's producer price index rose just 2.99% annually in August — and a near-flat 0.06% on the month, INEGI reports. Wholesale costs stay contained even as the peso trades near its strongest in over a year, meaning no hidden price shock queued up for consumers and no new taxes in the 2027 package.

🚨🇲🇽 <u>WHITE HOUSE GAMIFIED THE WALL — THEN TETRIS PULLED THE PLUG</u>

The Trump White House posted a "Build the Wall" video game on its official site — players stack blocks to keep migrants out — launched Sept 3 with "CAN'T STOP WINNING." By Sept 8 it was gone, yanked after the Tetris Company refused to let its mechanics be used "for divisive purposes," insisting "we believe in the power of connecting and uniting people." A government that turned the dehumanization of migrants into a browser game, killed by a copyright claim.

🇲🇽🚆 <u>5.7 TRILLION PESOS: MEXICO'S 2026-2030 BUILD-OUT</u>

The government will pour 5.7 trillion pesos into infrastructure and 1.8 million homes through 2030 — more than half for energy, the rest for trains, roads, ports, water and hospitals. Banobras chief Jorge Mendoza frames the public money to "expand productive capacity and improve regional connectivity," with public investment reaching 2.6% of GDP in 2027.

🔥🇲🇽 <u>US KNEW: SALINAS'S CAMPAIGN WAS GUARDED BY NARCOS</u>

A declassified November 1987 US Embassy memo states the security team of Carlos Salinas de Gortari's campaign "is headed by notorious drug traffickers" — Miguel Aldana and Armando Pavón Reyes, both later tied to the 1985 murder of DEA agent Camarena and charged alongside Caro Quintero. Washington's own verdict on the architect of Mexican neoliberalism: it "does not augur well for us, nor for Mexico."

🔥🇲🇽 <u>NO NEW TAXES — MEXICO GOES AFTER THE EVADERS INSTEAD</u>

Mexico's 2027 budget lifts tax revenue to a record 15.9% of GDP without a single new tax — by making corporations pay what they owe. Hacienda projects 185 billion pesos from shutting down evasion: 140bn from big firms (income over 50M pesos) gaming corporate ISR, plus 45bn from customs smuggling and undervaluation. Nearly a third of all new revenue, squeezed from evaders instead of from the people.

🚨🇲🇽 <u>RUBIO THREATENS MEXICO ON CARTELS — SHEINBAUM DOESN'T BLINK</u>

From Quito, Marco Rubio called Mexico's fight against the cartels "not even close to enough," claiming "vast territories" are beyond state control and warning the "threat will eventually have to be confronted one way or another." This about the country that logged 67,253 arrests and seized 34,353 guns — 80% smuggled from the US — while homicides fell 53%. Sheinbaum's reply: "we won't sign anything that affects our sovereignty." Cooperation, never subordination.

🇲🇽🔬 <u>Mexico's 2027 budget bets on science — up 18% in real terms</u>

The 2027 economic package earmarks 193 billion pesos for science, technology and innovation — an 18% real increase, per El Economista, with the science ministry's own budget up 13%. Education, science and culture together climb to 1.4 trillion pesos, 3.5% of GDP, and all of it with no new taxes and no new debt. After decades of neoliberal austerity starved Mexican science, the money is going back in.

🎶🇲🇽 <u>The Zócalo goes free for the 15th — Intocable headlines Independence</u>

Sheinbaum confirmed norteño legends Intocable will play a free concert in the Zócalo on September 15, the eve of the Grito de Independencia, for thousands of Mexican families. A Tejano-rooted band beloved on both sides of the border, headlining the nation's main square at no charge — the 4T's tradition of filling Mexico's most symbolic plaza with free culture for the people, not a ticketed spectacle.

🚨🇲🇽 <u>A third mayor cuffed in days — and this one's from Morena</u>

Federal and state forces arrested Isaac Rodríguez Ochoa, the Morena mayor of Esperanza, Puebla, along with his brother and his former police chief, for shielding the "Los Zúñiga" cargo-theft ring on the Puebla–Veracruz highway. Twenty-three raids turned up 35 guns — two of them Barrett rifles — plus a drone and a signal jammer. It's the third sitting mayor jailed in days, and the government didn't spare its own party to do it.
banner: PUEBLA: MORENA MAYOR JAILED IN THEFT RING

🔥🇲🇽 <u>Vulcan wanted $1.7 billion from Mexico — the tribunal said no</u>

US mining giant Vulcan Materials gouged limestone out of Calica, Quintana Roo, far beyond its permits — so Mexico turned the wrecked site into a protected natural area, and Vulcan ran to an ICSID tribunal demanding $1.7 billion. The panel just ruled the payout should be "considerably lower." Sheinbaum framed the fight plainly: "They want to take out the material they already dug up. What we want is the remediation of that place."
